title: Somehow I can just feel the engines roar
content: One of my semi-regular places in on a very red, "Age of Exploration" elite (space-race era) aircraft between NY and London-- though sometimes the destination differs. There's also fun because there a disused metro station with toll booths to cross through, and you meet interesting people. Just one night, though, I'd like to run into someone I know-- at and of "mallworld" -esque settings.
